name: cursor-usage-tracker
description: Captures every Cursor prompt, and switches on Claude Code usage reporting (terminal and VS Code), for your own dashboard website.

commands.title: Cursor Tracker: Connect Claude Code on this computer
Cursor Tracker: Stop tracking Claude Code on this computer
Cursor Tracker: Use a standalone tracker site (URL and API key)

cursorTracker.dashboardUrl.deprecationMessage: No longer used: run Cursor Tracker: Connect to dashboard with a setup code from an admin.

cursorTracker.trackerToken.deprecationMessage: No longer used: the token is kept in secure storage after Cursor Tracker: Connect to dashboard.

cursorTracker.serverUrl.description: Standalone tracker site (only if not using the RMW dashboard), e.g. https://usage.example.com

cursorTracker.userName.description: Your name on the dashboard. Each person sharing an account sets their own.

cursorTracker.apiKey.description: Must match TRACKER_API_KEY on the server.

cursorTracker.syncIntervalMinutes.description: How often to send new data.

cursorTracker.lookbackDays.description: Each sync re-sends this many days so late token counts get updated.

cursorTracker.firstSyncDays.description: How far back the very first sync goes.

cursorTracker.sendPromptText.description: Send the text of your prompts (Cursor and Claude Code). Turn off to send only tokens, models and costs.

cursorTracker.maxPromptChars.description: Longer prompts are cut to this length.

cursorTracker.fetchAccountUsage.description: Try to pull usage from cursor.com with your signed-in session. Doesn't work on Cursor 3, which encrypts the session; upload the usage CSV on the dashboard instead.

cursorTracker.databasePath.description: Override location of Cursor's state.vscdb (leave empty for auto).
